title_en: Account policy AP-1: two tiers, personal and team
note_en: Personal Free and Pro, plus a separate team tier. Free is capped by topic count (5), not by call volume. Paddle is the only payment provider.

title_en: Keep the site and the app in separate repositories
note_en: The homepage (site plus the account backend, private) and the app repository stay physically apart. This is an invariant, not a convenience.

title_en: Pin public keys only, never share secrets
note_en: The account service and the MCP server share no secret and no database. They pin each other's Ed25519 public key instead.

title_en: D-vis-0: audit the render pipeline before tuning it
note_en: Measure what the pipeline actually draws before changing any visual constant.

title_en: D-vis-a: honour recede, and let fog adapt
note_en: Depth cues must recede consistently; fog follows the scene rather than a fixed constant.

title_en: D-vis-b: recalibrate the mark and edge ladder behind two gates
note_en: Marks and edges get a re-derived size ladder, admitted only through two independent contrast gates.

title_en: D-vis-c: label legibility, with the user holding the dial
note_en: Labels must stay readable, and the reader keeps a control over density.

title_en: D-vis-d: semantic zoom drives shape and aggregation
note_en: Zoom level decides mark shape and how nodes aggregate, not just scale.

title_en: D11: the MCP tool contract, with the type vocabulary outside the graph
note_en: The MCP interface contract. R2 moved the type vocabulary out of the graph into themes.json.

title_en: D14: LadybugDB as the single embedded driver
note_en: Reversed and now current (v0.5.3): kuzu removed entirely, the dual-driver path retired. The clearest case of the R1 replacement insurance actually being claimed.

title_en: D15: five surfaces plus Settings
note_en: Revises the eight-screen plan (D8). Intake, Records, Atlas, Search, Packs.

title_en: D16: three levels of semantic zoom in Atlas
note_en: L0 is the domain map, L1 the domain lens, L2 the node focus.

title_en: D17: precompute the graph layout
note_en: The sidecar produces deterministic coordinates; the UI only consumes them.

title_en: D18: verb-first English copy system
note_en: A voice guide that forbids narration (F2), plus a four-state copy deck.

title_en: D19: Share Pack
note_en: A pack for moving data between accounts. Same shape as an MCP fragment; the receiver restamps ownership.

title_en: D26: an icon rail for the left navigation
note_en: Overturned twice since: D56 removed the rail, D69 brought a document tree back.

title_en: D31: two layers of expressive intensity in Atlas
note_en: The open layer belongs to the user (localStorage); the closed layer belongs to the spec (monochrome and the like).

title_en: D32: structural discipline for maps of content
note_en: Hub promotion follows a fixed order (pin over degree), and orphans are minimised through tie suggestions.

title_en: D35: reassign the primitives
note_en: Concept is a sphere, Domain a ringed body, Episode and Record hexagonal prisms, Bridge an octahedron.

title_en: D36: an opt-in remote MCP profile
note_en: A cloud-hosted MCP server living alongside the static homepage. Local stays the default, unchanged.

title_en: D37: keep Liquid Glass to the floating layer
note_en: Only floating chrome uses glass; the content plane stays flat.

title_en: D38: dark by default, and hide the developer surface
note_en: Surface copy drops endpoints, CLI names, and internal vocabulary.

title_en: D4: pack.json carries every signal
note_en: Preference and learner signals are recorded in full. This is a precondition for migration.

title_en: D42: ship English and Korean surfaces in one build
note_en: The copy deck is doubled and the OS locale picks the default.

title_en: D43: two decisions share this number (data home, and the three flat views)
note_en: Number used twice: (1) the default data home at ~/.vinc plus the P4 release pipeline, 2026-07-11; (2) the three flat Atlas views, flow, timeline and totals, approved 2026-07-24. New numbers must be grepped from the code and taken as max plus one.

title_en: D44: a zero-cost code signing path (superseded)
note_en: Going public to reach free SignPath signing. The premise did not hold: the repository is private. Superseded on 2026-07-30 by the decision to ship unsigned until v1.0.0.

title_en: D45: the document canon lives in chunks
note_en: Source text becomes internal to the graph as Chunk rows. This is the third path by which knowledge enters. Shipped in v0.6.5.

title_en: D46: an independent 2D renderer
note_en: Uses only the xy coordinates from the sidecar. The flat view carries the whole of L0 (D46-S).

title_en: D47: the totals view is a three-column Sankey
note_en: Marginal sums alone are enough to build it. This restores the spec rather than adding a feature.

title_en: D48-T: own the tooltip (WCAG 1.4.13)
note_en: A single data-tip attribute; the native title attribute is removed everywhere.

title_en: D53: retire the flow view
note_en: Five views become four. The entry point to the relationship evidence panel moves to clicking a line in 2D.

title_en: D54: show the provenance column in the ledger
note_en: Only the web fills it in, so there is a version skew against the desktop release.

title_en: D55: zip is the pack container
note_en: Two formats can be read (zip and JSON); only zip is written.

title_en: D56: a single shell with one top bar
note_en: The left navigation is removed and the top bar unified (v0.6.7). Overturned again by D69.

title_en: D57: search is the first way in
note_en: Clicking a result lands on that node.

title_en: D6: pack export defaults to include_model=False
note_en: The learner section is not exposed. True only for a lossless transfer.

title_en: D63: two decisions share this number (overlay spec, and path tuples)
note_en: One unified spec for elements drawn over the canvas (v0.6.7) coexists in the code with an unrelated use of the same number. A worked example of the numbering backlog.

title_en: D68: barycentre placement for the alluvial Sankey
note_en: Lode placement, an other bucket, and gaps demoted to an aggregate. Total crossings are invariant; the wander metric belongs to L2.

title_en: D69: bring the document tree back to the left column
note_en: A 232px domain-to-document tree ordered by concept depth. The first screen is the whole graph. This reverses both D26 and D56.

title_en: D7: one profile, no password, by default
note_en: Sign-in is not the first screen; it is an opt-in lock under Settings.

title_en: D70: focus means a card of related documents
note_en: Focusing a node offers cards for the documents you can move to. The right panel is for source text only and its width is adjustable.

title_en: D71: one Tools modal, and chrome rearranged
note_en: Import and share collapse into a single Tools entry: create, import, share.

title_en: D72: split the time axis in two
note_en: Recorded time against content time (schema v7). Old rows must not be backfilled.

title_en: D73: two modes in the search bar, and asking without a language model
note_en: The top search bar splits into find and ask. A dropdown at the left end doubles as the icon slot. Still a candidate: neither the name (chat against ask) nor the placement (its own surface against a Search mode) is settled. Summarising and synthesis are excluded permanently.

title_en: D74: put the hierarchy into the coordinates, and explode the layout
note_en: The domain string is read as a path so that root, topic and concept hierarchy lands in the coordinates themselves. Ordering by centrality becomes an exploded layout, and centrality moves inside each branch. Two coordinate sets are emitted (x/y/z is canonical for 3D, x2/y2 for 2D); 2D is not a flattened 3D. Flattening z would collapse distinct nodes onto one point and lose them. Old sidecars have no x2/y2 and degrade gracefully to x/y.

title_en: D75: stop the vanishing in Atlas
D76: two contrast gates for Atlas
D77: retire the glass, and clear the dead channels
D78: type is colour, and the palette is closed at five
D79: restore line width (Line2)
D80: open on the local graph by default

GM-2: place the conventions in the file, the store, and a read tool
note_en: Repository file, then store document, then vinc_conventions. MCP resources are on hold.

title_en: GM-3: canon per region of the file
note_en: The generated region belongs to the store, the prose to the file. Regeneration never overwrites what a person wrote.

title_en: GM-4: build and check for graph-md
note_en: Nine shape rules, exit codes 0, 1 and 2. It does not inspect meaning.

title_en: GM-5: four pages for graph-md on the docs site
note_en: /docs/graph-md/{,build,spec,check}

title_en: GM-7: keep the conventions document out of the listings
note_en: Excluded from search, the document list, and the left tree. It is a rule, not content.

title_en: GM-8: a control sheet
note_en: A top-bar icon, a proposal badge, and approve, reject or rename.

title_en: GM-9: a token budget for child vectors
SEC-1: owner isolation on reads
note_en: A probe run right after deploy found nodes from another owner exposed. Fixed in two layers, stamping and query.

title_en: SEC-3: owner isolation on writes
note_en: Closes the live cross-tenant write holes in delete, merge and ingest. The threat premise is that content-derived ids are guessable.

title_en: (deleted: the type replaces the registry)
note_en: This node existed only to say that decisions exist as a class. That is what the Decision type now says. The two facts worth keeping (the number-reuse backlog for D43 and D63) already live in those two decisions' own notes.
